headline: Maine State Police investigate deaths of woman and two children found in submerged vehicle
dek: A 61-year-old Mount Desert woman and her two young grandchildren were recovered Sunday from a vehicle in Roque Bluffs’ Pond Cove. The cause and manner of death remain under investigation.
body: Maine State Police are investigating the deaths of a Mount Desert woman and her two grandchildren after their vehicle was found submerged Sunday morning in Pond Cove in Roque Bluffs.

The victims were identified as 61-year-old Sharon Bukulmez of Mount Desert and her grandchildren, 5-year-old Kinsley Grubb and 3-year-old Sawyer Grubb, both of Bar Harbor, according to police information reported by the Bangor Daily News. Police said the three had been traveling to Machias after leaving a family gathering in Jonesboro on Saturday night and did not arrive as expected.

Bar Harbor police used location information from Bukulmez’s cellphone to identify an area near the boat ramp at the end of Schoppee Point Road. Maine State Police, the state police dive team and Maine Marine Patrol located the vehicle at about 7 a.m. and recovered the three bodies, police said.

The Washington County Sheriff’s Office and Coast Guard also assisted. The bodies were taken to the Office of Chief Medical Examiner in Augusta for autopsies, which will help determine the cause and manner of death. Police said the circumstances remain under investigation and released no additional details.
author: NorthEast News Desk
